description.description: What the watch waits for, in 5-10 words. The user sees it on its card.

containers.description: By exact name. Omit for the default container.

previous.description: The instance before the last restart.

filters.description: Keep only lines from nodes with these names, or region, zone, os or arch labels.

grep.description: A regular expression the message must match. Omit for any line.

since.description: Where the watch starts: an RFC 3339 time, or a duration back from now such as PT10M. Omit for now. Not with cursor.

until.description: When the watch ends: an RFC 3339 time, or a duration from now such as PT2H. At most a day, the default.

cursor.description: A next or follow token a read printed, copied exactly: the watch goes on from there. Not with sources, filters, grep or since.

limit.description: Matching lines that end the watch. Default 1.

max_bytes.description: Bytes of matching lines that end the watch. Default 16384.
